🔍 SpotDifference

Two images appear side by side — they look identical but have subtle differences. Free, no ads, no login — play instantly on Bytecade Games.

How to Play

  1. Study both images carefully and compare them.
  2. Click on a spot where you see a difference.
  3. Common differences: missing objects, color changes, size differences, position shifts.
  4. Find all differences to complete the puzzle.
  5. Some differences are very subtle — look at every detail.
